title: CoNP-completeness of checking minimum-weight SAT models
claims: MinimumWeightSATModelCheckingCoNPComplete proves coNP-completeness for checking a satisfying assignment with the fewest true occurring names.
The polynomial reduction introduces a selector and one fresh penalty name per original variable, with explicit handling of repeated names and malformed encodings.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
